outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: None that matter here (formatting of the listed items is fine in principle).

Critical issues: (1) Filter application is not evidenced/verified. The agent claims the “Accounts” checkbox is visibly present and checked and that results are filtered, but the provided DOM snapshots do not show any “Filter by category” UI, any checked Accounts checkbox state, or any visible indication that an Accounts filter is applied. With only one click recorded in the action history and no DOM confirmation, the hard requirement “Stop after the Accounts filter is visibly applied” is not met from the evidence. (2) The three reported filings appear fabricated relative to the available ground truth. The DOM evidence shown contains no filing list rows at all (no dates, types, or descriptions are visible), so the specific filing dates (25 Jul 2026, 15 Jul 2025, 02 Jul 2024) and descriptions cannot be grounded in what was actually displayed, and directly conflict with the requirement to preserve text “exactly as displayed.”

Outcome assessment: The agent did reach the correct Tesco PLC filing history page (supported by DOM). However, the primary deliverable was to (a) visibly apply the Accounts filter through the page interface and (b) accurately record the three newest displayed account filings. Since neither the applied filter state nor any of the filings are actually shown/confirmed in the DOM evidence, and the agent nonetheless reported specific filings and asserted the filter was applied, the task is not successfully completed for an average user who needs reliable, page-derived filing information.
